title: Keyboard Navigation and Focus/ARIA Chronology — addendum and baseline observations

observationSurface.roles: role="combobox" on input, role="listbox", role="option", role="status", role="tooltip"
observationSurface.aria: aria-expanded and aria-activedescendant read from the combobox element; active option resolved by id
observationSurface.events: open / close CustomEvent.detail (observed {}) and onOpen/onClose callbacks
observationSurface.dom: data-open on host, data-placement on dropdown/listbox, dir on host, shadowRoot.activeElement

baselineObservations.arrowdown_on_closed: opens; data-open=true; aria-expanded=true; aria-activedescendant=null; emits open:{} then onOpen
baselineObservations.arrowdown_move_sequence_items_a_b_disabl: a -> c -> d -> d -> d (first move lands on first selectable a; skips disabled b; clamps at d)
baselineObservations.arrowup_move_sequence: c -> a -> a -> a (clamps at a)
baselineObservations.home_end: from active c: End -> d (last selectable); Home -> a (first selectable)
baselineObservations.escape_open: emits close:{}; data-open removed; aria-expanded=false; detail carries no reason
baselineObservations.aria_label_description: aria-label applied to combobox + listbox; aria-description applied to combobox
baselineObservations.aria_busy_resync: aria-busy attribute written to host routes to _syncListboxAccessibility; no aria-busy observed on the listbox element in jsdom (P1.3-D02)
baselineObservations.data_open: data-open="true" while open; attribute absent when closed
baselineObservations.open_close_idempotency: open();open();close();close() emits open then close exactly once each

deviationCandidates.summary: Public close event detail is {} (CloseEventDetail empty); engine CloseReason not surfaced on the public event; keyboard Escape vs Tab emit indistinguishable close:{}
aria-busy attributeChangedCallback routes to _syncListboxAccessibility, but no aria-busy attribute observed on the listbox element and no change on toggle at baseline (observable effect unconfirmed)

Open assigns no initial aria-activedescendant when no selection (intentional per code comment); first ArrowDown materializes first selectable option. Differs from some APG examples; recorded, not fixed.

carriedForwardEvidence.note: No executable code changed in this addendum; the full core suite is not rerun for a documentation-only commit.
